data.name: Pankaj
data.gender_notes: Pankaj is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit paṅka, 'mud', + ja, 'born' — 'born of mud', i.e. the lotus. Its root is Sanskrit paṅka + ja. A classical Sanskrit term for the lotus. Pankaj is a Sanskrit name meaning “Lotus; born of mud”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Pankaj expresses “Lotus; born of mud”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit paṅka, 'mud', + ja, 'born' — 'born of mud', i.e. the lotus.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pankaj total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
